sql_problem.title: On the heat kernel of a Cayley graph of $\operatorname{PSL}_2\mathbb{Z}$: the completeness of the eigenfunction family
sql_problem.difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's completeness proposition (source0.tex lines 1524-1529, source label completeness1): the family of eigenfunctions of the discrete Laplacian on the Cayley graph, together with the continuous family of Eisenstein-type functions, satisfies the orthonormality relation sum_epsilon f_epsilon(m) f_epsilon(n) + integral over the continuous parameter = delta_{m,n}. The retained complete proof (lines 1532-1613) is a genuine 82-line computation, not a routine verification: it isolates the diagonal and off-diagonal cases, rewrites the continuous contribution through an explicit kernel, evaluates the resulting contour integrals by splitting the parameter range, and matches the residues with the discrete eigenfunctions so that only the Kronecker delta survives. The residual difficulty is the uniform control of an integral against the weight 1/H together with a case-by-case evaluation of the spectral measures; this is research-level harmonic analysis on graphs well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying exercises.
